2014_spells.elemental-bane-4.description: Choose one creature you can see within range, and choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the spell. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type.
2014_spells.elemental-bane-4.effectSumma: The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type
2014_spells.elemental-bane-4.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, choose one creature you can see within range, and choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type; The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or be affected by the spell; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
